positions.commentary: The speaker states that over the last 26 years, over 80% of NVR's shares outstanding have been bought back.
The speaker notes that Microsoft provided zero returns until 2015/16 and was a violent ride with huge drops, making it hard to hold.

The speaker does not understand Amazon's retail business because the last mile delivery costs are extremely high relative to item prices, but he decides to ignore the business since he doesn't understand it.
The speaker believes Costco has a very solid moat due to goodwill with customers and execution, though he only fully understands the business at a high valuation multiple.
The speaker notes that Berkshire Hathaway has made many retail investments that did not work well, except for Nebraska Furniture Mart, and that the industry is essentially a graveyard.
The speaker views Walmart as a good business that does well but requires incredible execution and constant effort to win back customer loyalty against new entrants like Amazon.
